components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 600 0.9375rem Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1.5px solid; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.3 0.055 158); border-color: oklch(0.3 0.055 158); color: oklch(0.985 0.005 140); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.3 0.055 158) 86%, oklch(0.22 0.035 155)); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.5 0.17 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tag-stock button with ink border for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-sec { font: 600 0.9375rem Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; background: oklch(0.994 0.004 120); color: oklch(0.22 0.035 155); border: 1.5px solid oklch(0.22 0.035 155); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-sec:hover { background: oklch(0.953 0.014 140); } .ds-btn-sec:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.5 0.17 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Location search input sharing the button's 44px ink-bordered shape.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="City or town, e.g. Kelowna…" />
components.css: .ds-input { font: 500 0.9375rem Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; width: 260px; color: oklch(0.22 0.035 155); background: oklch(0.994 0.004 120); border: 1.5px solid oklch(0.22 0.035 155); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.44 0.03 155); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.5 0.17 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Stake-green header with condensed wordmark, PROTOTYPE stamp and outlined location button.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; background: oklch(0.3 0.055 158); color: oklch(0.975 0.01 140); } .ds-brand { font: 700 1.5rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-stamp { font: 600 0.75rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; padding: 3px 6px 2px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-loc { margin-left: auto; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 500 0.9375rem Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.975 0.01 140) 55%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-loc:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.975 0.01 140) 14%, transparent); }

components.name: Verdict Tag
components.description: Signature component: category-filled tag with clipped corners, punched hole, giant verdict word and drop gauge.
components.css: .ds-tag { position: relative; width: 340px; padding: 52px 28px 28px; background: oklch(0.5 0.15 252); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); clip-path: polygon(26px 0, calc(100% - 26px) 0, 100% 26px, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 26px); } .ds-tag::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-left: -8px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.925 0.022 140); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.99 0 0) 28%, transparent); } .ds-tag-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-tag-day { font: 600 1.375rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-tag-word { font: 700 4.5rem/0.85 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-drop { width: 36px; height: 36px; margin-right: 6px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-drop.on { fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Zone Row (running)
components.description: Simulated zone in running state: tinted fill, blue state chip, large timer, progress line.
components.css: .ds-zone { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 360px; padding: 14px 16px 16px; border: 1.5px solid oklch(0.5 0.15 252); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(0.95 0.03 250); overflow: hidden; color: oklch(0.22 0.035 155); } .ds-zone-name { font: 700 1.375rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-zone-state { padding: 2px 6px 1px; margin-left: 8px; border: 1.5px solid oklch(0.5 0.15 252); border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.5 0.15 252); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); font: 700 0.75rem/1.2 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-zone-timer { font: 700 2.25rem/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-zone-progress { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 4px; } .ds-zone-progress div { height: 100%; width: 60%; background: oklch(0.5 0.15 252); }

components.name: Graduated Stake Bar
components.description: Savings progress bar with a ruler tick every 10%.
components.css: .ds-bar { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 22px; border: 2px solid oklch(0.22 0.035 155); background: oklch(0.953 0.014 140); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 calc(10% - 2px), oklch(0.22 0.035 155) calc(10% - 2px) 10%); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 45%, transparent 45%); mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 45%, transparent 45%); } .ds-bar-fill { height: 100%; width: 62%; background: oklch(0.47 0.115 148); }

narrative.overview:
The interface is the plastic care tag stuck in a plant pot. Today's verdict is a full-bleed tag in its category colour, with a punched hole and clipped corners, and the amount of water is read from a three-drop pictogram rather than decoration. Everything else is tag stock: white panels with a 2px ink rule under each heading, laid on a pale sage ground beneath a stake-green header band. The dark theme is a greenhouse at dusk, the same system with the ground dropped to near-black green and the category hues lifted to light tints.

Density is moderate and information-first. Numbers and labels are set in Barlow Condensed so figures read like stamped specs; reading text is Barlow. Every figure carries its unit. Depth is almost absent: a hairline and a faint ambient shadow, never a lifted card.
keyCharacteristics: Flat category fills carry meaning: one hue per verdict (WATER, REDUCE, DELAY, SKIP, OFF).
Water level is a 0 to 3 drop pictogram, filled by how much water the plan gives.
Ink rules (2px) under headings and as ruler ticks; 1.5px hairline rows for spec tables.
Condensed uppercase for labels and numerals, tight tracking on big words, open tracking on small ones.
Authored moment: the verdict rises in and drops fill one by one; otherwise motion is state feedback only.

rules.name: The One Hue Per Verdict Rule
rules.body: A category colour appears only as its own verdict (fill, drops, stub header). Water Blue also marks water itself (rain, running). No category colour is used decoratively.

rules.name: The Paired Text Rule
rules.body: Each category defines its fill, the text on that fill, and a text-on-tag-stock variant. Never put raw fill colour as small text on tag stock when a -ct variant exists.

rules.name: The Unit Always Rule
rules.body: A figure is never shown without its unit beside it (mm, L, degC, km/h, %).

rules.name: The Tag Stock Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from fill, ink rules and tag shape, not from lifted cards.

dos: Do colour a verdict with its single category fill and pair it with its defined on-colour.
Do show water level as the three-drop pictogram (WATER 3, REDUCE 2, DELAY 1, SKIP and OFF 0).
Do put a 2px ink rule under panel headings and keep spec rows hairline-ruled.
Do set numerals in Barlow Condensed 700 and label them with units.
Do keep disclosures (PROTOTYPE, simulated, Open-Meteo attribution) visible.
Do design dark as its own theme with lifted category hues and dark-on-light fills.
donts: Don't return to the white-card bento look with a single teal accent.
Don't use category hues for decoration or as a second accent on neutral UI.
Don't lift panels with heavy shadows; depth is fill, rule and shape.
Don't add icons or pictograms that carry no information.
Don't set small text in a raw category fill on tag stock; use its text variant.
